240-647-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-647-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2393-4279-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2440-3490-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2440-3490-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
2440-3490-6495.notes:
If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4050-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4050-5254-7741.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Repeat.

2577-4826-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-4826-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2783-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2783-6495-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

277-2557-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1308-4365-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-4365-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1594-4399-4770-7399.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Bogwater Lumaret trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-7399.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

6797-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
6797-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4694-4779-7652.easyPrerequisites: Tom, Bert, and William is an artifact.
4694-4779-7652.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-3480-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

277-774-5233.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Boros Garrison.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Boros Garrison's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-774-5233.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

2919-4050-5086-5183-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4050-5086-5183-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

1879-2366-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1879-2366-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1424-2335-2433.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

3259-5722-6965.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-6965.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

277-681-1669-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
277-681-1669-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

3705-5231-6887-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2511-3234-3293-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2511-3234-3293-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat
2511-3234-3293-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1109-2178-2760.notablePrerequisites: A player controls another creature with toughness equal to 1.
1109-2178-2760.description:
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on target creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness, triggering Nest of Scarabs and Skeleton Ship.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Skeleton Ship trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

3053-3918-4038.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
3053-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

228-2034-2351-4962.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
228-2034-2351-4962.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to another creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature was a Tentacle, and Skullclamp triggers.
Resolve the Watcher trigger, if applicable, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on a permanent.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1912-4499-6463.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Meticulous Artisan.
When Meticulous Artisan enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

92-1561-2302-6317.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing you to draw half your library and lose half your life total, rounding up each time.
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Martyr of Sands by paying {1}, revealing all white cards in your hand and sacrificing Martyr of Sands, causing you to gain 3 life for each card revealed this way.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

708-2500-4000-4050.notablePrerequisites: Mirage Mirror on the battlefield as a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2500-4000-4050.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rhys, adding {G/W}.
Choose to return Rhys to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirage Mirror trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rhys from the command zone by paying {G/W}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2499-2733-4826-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

386-5280-5919.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
386-5280-5919.notablePrerequisites: Glistening Oil attached to Razorkin Needlehead.
386-5280-5919.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

3967-4089-5011.description:
Activate Yahenni, Undying Partisan by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Yahenni, Undying Partisan ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1462-1748-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1462-1748-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an additional creature.
When the creature dies as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Warehouse Tabby triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-2459-2744-5224.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2459-2744-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
When Rograkh dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1704-2232-2421-2459-4050.notablePrerequisites: Rograkh and You have enough mana to pay for Rograkh's commander tax, if applicable.
1704-2232-2421-2459-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}.
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Krark to your hand from the battlefield.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {1}.
Cast Krark by paying {1}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Skyfire Phoenix enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
When Krark enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1308-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

631-2034-4871-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself, Grim Haruspex, and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

397-2438-4871.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Citizen.
The Citizen dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3026-4302-4802-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Angel, adding {R}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2348-5158.description:
Nature's Revolt turns all lands into creatures.
Elesh Norn causes opponent' creatures to get -2/-2, killing all opponent' lands.

1309-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
1309-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the token Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

29-137.notablePrerequisites:
Kaalia of the Vast does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Kaalia of the Vast.
That opponent cannot block Master of Cruelties.
29-137.description:
Declare Kaalia of the Vast as an attacker.
Kaalia of the Vast triggers, causing you to put Master of Cruelties from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Master of Cruelties isn't blocked, it triggers, causing defending player's life total to become 1 and causing Master of Cruelties to deal no combat damage this turn.
Kaalia of the Vast deals lethal combat damage to defending player.

651-1946-2603.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Nomads en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.
